points.description: Chooses C (the water level went up) AND explains that water expands when it freezes (ice takes up more space/volume than liquid water). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award no marks if only C is chosen without a correct explanation, or if the explanation is given but the wrong option is chosen.

rubric.notes: Full mark: selects C and explains that water expands on freezing. No marks for A or B, or for C with no/incorrect explanation.
